storage.identity: projectUuid is persistent product identity; legacy WORK ProjectId/root registration key retained as alias, never automatically rewritten in run/lease records
storage.draft: Save Draft explicitly creates owned project folder and definition on first save. UI previews path and says no skeleton generated. Later resume is explicit open of this saved draft, not a new-project overwrite exception.
storage.legacy: Open legacy root read-only with legacy marker; first explicit adopt/save previews new definition only, preserves ESS/preferences/manifest bytes; existing projectUuid conflict blocks.
storage.copy: Explicit copy creates new projectUuid + origin reference; same UUID at two roots must be diagnosed and require explicit move/copy choice, not auto remap.
